task_description:
Controlled trace-replay step 1 of 2. Perform EXACTLY one MCP action and nothing else: activate the MCP tool group "laplace_math_mcp" (server: Math MCP), then call its tool "max".

Purpose in the larger task: determine which California national park has the highest annual visitation, so that a later step can geocode its main entrance.

Input for the "max" call — use these California national park visitation figures (annual recreation visitors):
- Death Valley National Park: 1,096,525
- Yosemite National Park: 3,882,740
- Joshua Tree National Park: 2,865,425
- Sequoia National Park: 1,019,395
- Lassen Volcanic National Park: 499,917
- Channel Islands National Park: 431,577
- Pinnacles National Park: 431,577
- Redwood National Park: 427,098
- Del Norte Coast Redwoods State Park: 200,000
- Lava Beds National Monument: 348,547

Report back concisely: (a) whether the group activated successfully, (b) the exact raw output/return value of the "max" tool, and (c) which park name corresponds to that maximum. If the group or tool is unavailable, say so explicitly. If the call returns an error or times out, state clearly that it was skipped and do NOT retry, invent, or substitute results. Do not call any other tools.

Controlled trace-replay step 2 of 2. Perform EXACTLY one MCP action and nothing else: activate the MCP tool group "laplace_google_maps" (server: Google Maps), then call its tool "maps_geocode".

Context: step 1 ("max" on laplace_math_mcp) was SKIPPED because that group was unavailable in this environment, so no verified tool output was carried forward. The most visited California national park per the visitation list supplied in the original request is Yosemite National Park (3,882,740 annual visitors). Use its main entrance for the geocode input.

Input for the "maps_geocode" call — the address string:
"Big Oak Flat Entrance, Yosemite National Park, CA 95389" (main north entrance to Yosemite; if you prefer a single canonical entrance address, "Yosemite Valley Visitor Center, Yosemite National Park, CA 95389" is an acceptable alternative). Pass only the address as the tool's address parameter; do not add other parameters unless required by the tool schema.

Report back concisely: (a) whether the group "laplace_google_maps" activated successfully, (b) the exact raw return value of "maps_geocode" including latitude/longitude, formatted address, and place/location ID if present, and (c) any error message verbatim. If the group or tool is unavailable, say so explicitly. If the call errors or times out, state clearly that it was skipped and do NOT retry, invent, fabricate, or substitute coordinates from your own knowledge. Do not call any other tools (no browser, no web search, no other MCP servers).
